scope: Source-identity continuity for immutable qualification cohorts after a metadata-only repository history rewrite.
checked: Each replacement commit is an ancestor of the rewritten main branch.
Each replacement commit resolves to the tree recorded by the immutable cohort manifest.
The runner, rules, and fixture blobs are revalidated from the replacement tree against the immutable manifest hashes.
not_checked: Availability of commit objects that are no longer retained by a current branch or tag.
Repository objects held only by historical pull-request references or external copies.
